verdicts.reason: The two candidates are nearly the same layout. Both are a centred copy of the original with wide empty side margins, and neither rearranges anything for the square format. Both share the same faults: the 'missing asset' placeholder box covers the end of the legal line, a bokeh dot sits on the body copy ('bottled'), the 'AWARD WINNING 2026' pill has lost its dark fill so it no longer matches the other badges, and the legal text is too small to read. The only difference is the SOLSTICE logo. In A it is noticeably undersized, while B keeps it scaled in proportion to the original, so B wins by a slight margin.
